company1.description: Frontend Developer with 3 years of experience in Angular and TypeScript, working on the evolution of scalable ERP web systems. Experience in legacy system refactoring, REST API integration and multi-tenant solution implementation. Focus on performance, usability and code quality, with hands-on experience in AWS, Docker and CI/CD to support the development and deployment cycle.
company1.frontendDescription: Implemented legacy system refactoring that enabled a multi-tenant (white-label) architecture, increasing ERP scalability and enabling new clients and revenue. Worked on the analysis and definition of architecture for strategic integrations, including ERP with Zoho CRM and the Gupshup API (WhatsApp), enabling user synchronization and messaging process automation.
company1.frontendDetail1: Development and evolution of ERP web applications with Angular, improving performance by approximately 50–60%
company1.frontendDetail2: Experience with microfrontend architecture using Single-SPA for composition and decoupling of Angular applications
company1.frontendDetail3: Integration of Angular applications with REST APIs built in .NET
company1.frontendDetail4: Configuration and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines with Docker on Azure DevOps, deploying to AWS (S3, CloudFront, Route 53)
company1.frontendDetail5: Consistent practice of Code Reviews in the development process, following SOLID principles and Design Patterns, always ensuring code quality
company1.frontendDetail6: Led adoption of new tools and AI for development automation (e.g. ClaudeCode, ChatGPT), increasing team productivity by up to 70%
company1.backendDescription: On the backend, I maintained an API for generating reports that can be exported in XLSX, CSV, HTML and PDF. With the updates I implemented, users noticed greater integration with tools like Excel (XLSX and CSV) and the browser itself (PDF).
company1.backendDetail1: Development and evolution of ERP web system using Angular (microfrontends with Single-SPA) and REST APIs in Java (Spring Boot 3), improving application performance by approximately 50–60% after structural optimizations
company1.backendDetail2: Implementation and maintenance of reporting APIs with export to XLSX, CSV, HTML and PDF, expanding integration with external tools and improving user experience
company1.backendDetail3: Query and endpoint optimization in the backend (Java + MySQL and Oracle databases), enabling higher concurrent user volume and reducing resource consumption
company1.backendDetail4: Refactoring of Python scripts responsible for report versioning and storage, eliminating duplications and significantly reducing AWS S3 costs
company1.backendDetail5: Configuration and automation of CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Azure DevOps, deploying to AWS (S3, CloudFront, Route 53) and accelerating the delivery cycle
company1.backendDetail6: Led adoption of AI tools (ChatGPT, ClaudeCode), increasing team productivity by up to 70%
company1.backendDetail7: Continuous application of best practices (SOLID, Design Patterns) and code reviews, raising code quality and maintainability
